title: Fix 'zsh: command not found: python' on macOS
summary: macOS does not have a command called python. The Terminal uses python3 instead. These steps check that python3 is installed and show its version.

aliases.text: python command not found macos terminal
mac python not working in terminal
why does python not work on mac
python command not found на маке
python не работает в терминале на маке
почему python не запускается на маке

steps.explain: macOS does not provide a command named python. Use python3 instead. This command checks that python3 is installed and shows where it is. It only reads information.
steps.expect: A path such as /usr/bin/python3 or /opt/homebrew/bin/python3. If nothing is printed, python3 is not installed.

steps.explain: Show the Python version. Type python3 in place of python in every command you find online. On a Mac without Command Line Tools, /usr/bin/python3 may open a window asking to install them; you can click Cancel.

alternatives.explain: The same check with the short option -V.
